Principles

Reversibility

Refuse to normalize at ingestion where the decision is irreversible. Normalize in the warehouse where a wrong model is a redefinition, not a migration.

Operational simplicity

Abstractions cost clarity under pressure. Ship what's straightforward to operate and debug. Only abstract where the operational burden actually drives the design.

Ship in trust order, not sophistication order

Built manual recommendation blocks first (zero intelligence, but deployable day one), then automated, then smart. Clients who started on manual graduated to smart. Sophistication matters less than adoption; adoption requires trust.
